_provenance: Population counts from Kaplan 2022 (arXiv:2105.09438) Tables 1-6; witnesses generated by tools/classify.py (own encoder + exact-cover corona search) and independently verified by heesch_verify in strict mode.

complete_families.note: the V-heptiamond, the unique heptiamond non-tiler (Gardner/Golomb; Kaplan 2022): Hc=Hh=1 exactly by exhaustive corona search (tools/classify.py _explore terminates). Audit 2026-08: it had been wrongly entered in known_tilers.json as a tiler, so GATE_IS_TILER rejected its legitimate witnesses.

census CLOSED by v2: the last Hc=1 octomino identified via F(S,2) UNSAT (W<=1 => Hh<=1, quantified over all patches) + extracted hole-free 1-corona witness => Hc=Hh=1 exactly. Solver cadical195, dev-tier (record-tier proof artifact via §9.8).

partial_families.proven_exact: all three corpus hexes are F(S,2)-UNSAT: Hc=Hh=1 exactly (v2)

open_shape.proven: non-tiler with W<=2 (F(S,3) UNSAT) and Hc>=1; Hc in {1,2}, Hh<=2
open_shape.evidence: no hole-free 2-corona among 200k enumerated weak 2-configs (capped, not exhausted); classifier budget-capped at reached=1
open_shape.conflict: Kaplan's published 06hex_0up.txt lists this shape as Hc = 2, Hh = 2 (heesch_verify/known_nontilers.json carries those values). Our F(S,3) is UNSAT (Hh <= 2, consistent) and F(S,2) is SAT, but neither the exact-cover classifier (25 min) nor 200 000 enumerated F(S,2) models (all with a hole in corona 2) produced a hole-free 2-corona witness as of 2026-08-17. Recorded as open; the harness would accept a submitted 2-corona witness and rejects anything deeper (CENSUS_CONTRADICTION).
